formal_statement: ∀ R m0 : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, m0 ≤ m ∧ 1 ≤ m ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, PEqualNP.Gct.HasBorderDetExpression (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) n → R * m ^ 2 ≤ n
plain_statement: For every R there are arbitrarily large m such that every border determinantal expression of perm_m over C has size at least R m^2 (border as in L-gct-010). Past the m^2/2 of Landsberg, Manivel and Ressayre (2013) for large m, with no explicit growth rate; implied by the unrefereed 2026 cubic claim (L-gct-026). Route (ours, conjecture): a block sum of sums of r x r subpermanents is an affine restriction of the permanent; its gradient has no nonzero zero on a large subspace because rows of a singular point take boundedly many values; then L-gct-053, L-gct-024, L-gct-023.
title: Superquadratic: border determinantal complexity of perm_m is not O(m^2)
